card.name: Word starts after headings or partway through words
card.fires_on: Responds to "Mild" starting a severity row in dosing tables, and to the second piece of split words like Vis-ually, Cardi-ogenic and All-ergic.

modes.label: Mild in dosing tables
modes.description: The word Mild opens an impairment or severity row right after a dosage heading.

modes.label: Inside split words
modes.description: The middle piece of a word split into parts, often at the start of a preparation instruction or a condition name.
modes.example: Preparation of Cisatracurium Besylate Injection Vis<<ually>> inspect Cisatracurium Bes

card.plain: It fires on the word Mild opening a kidney or liver impairment dosing row, and on the middle of some long split words.
